parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 and neither image has a critical defect, but the totals are A 32 and B 30. That difference of 2 is more than 1, so the images are not at parity.

reference.summary: Santa rides a kick scooter across snowy ground at night, one hand on the handlebar and the other holding a stack of gifts, with a full moon and speed lines; the drawing is clean and lively.

defects.what: The stack of gifts seems to float beside Santa, and only the lowest box touches his gloved hand
defects.where: the gift stack on the left of Santa
defects.expected: The gifts look clearly carried, either held firmly against his body or resting on the scooter deck

defects.what: The hat's tip shoots high up and back in a long, stiff curve, so it looks like a hook more than a floppy hat
defects.expected: The hat tip droops or trails naturally behind his head

defects.what: A small dark curved shape sticks up from the back end of the deck and is hard to identify
defects.expected: The rear of the scooter reads clearly as a fender or brake, or the stray shape is gone

attempt.summary: Santa stands on a kick scooter in a snowy night landscape under a full moon, gripping the handlebar and holding a small yellow gift, with a sack of presents on the deck behind him; the figure is readable but stiff and blocky.

defects.what: Santa's body is built from stiff, narrow rectangles, with thin straight legs and arms, so he looks thin and wooden instead of round and jolly
defects.expected: Santa has a rounded, plump body and natural limbs, so he reads at once as a jolly Santa

defects.what: Santa's face and beard are small compared to his body, which makes the character harder to recognise
defects.expected: A fuller white beard and a face in proportion, so Santa is instantly recognisable

defects.what: The blue gift sits flat on the front of the sack and reads as a sticker more than a present inside the sack or beside it
defects.where: the sack at the back of the deck
defects.expected: The gift clearly sticks out of the sack's opening or stands next to it

defects.what: The steering post is not clearly joined to the front of the deck, so the front of the scooter looks loosely put together
defects.where: the front of the scooter, where the post meets the deck and wheel
defects.expected: The steering post clearly connects the handlebar, the deck and the front wheel as one sturdy scooter
